title: Prove accepted Atlas UX convergence merge after historical router false negative
purpose: Close the already-completed Atlas #352 promotion cleanly by independently proving the exact accepted R15 merge topology, promoted blob identity, accepted artifact identity and learner-journey suite after the generic historical Wave A post-merge router produced a false negative. The exact promotion is historical and immutable, so this work package deliberately adds a bounded recovery verifier instead of permanent one-off routing code.
invariants: Only the dedicated recovery verifier and CI-WP-015 metadata change.
The verifier is bound to historical promotion merge 2b2914874caa6be1b5dca0ea1756837d47bc7c11 and accepted R15 product head 88cad160714830462234970276c808c42b4a2579.
The promotion requires exactly two parents and accepted second parent 88cad160714830462234970276c808c42b4a2579.
The exact first-parent delta is the fourteen paths carried by accepted PR #354.
Every promoted path blob at merge HEAD equals the accepted product-head blob.
The verifier reruns the same build, syntax, Atlas core, learning, experience, integration and UX-clarity suite used by atlas-ux-convergence against the merge tree.
Both accepted product head and promotion merge rebuild to exactly 421487 bytes with SHA-256 0b268c9af10677617815e821389944bf9158d1fa10a7049ebc7b0082cceec2dd.
The historical failed generic Wave A run remains evidence of a CI topology false negative and is not rewritten or hidden.
requiredEvidence: Dedicated recovery verifier PASS on the pull-request head.
Historical merge 2b2914874caa6be1b5dca0ea1756837d47bc7c11 has the exact expected fourteen-path first-parent delta and accepted second parent.
Every promoted path blob equals the accepted R15 product-head blob.
The exact accepted R15 test suite passes against the historical promotion merge tree.
Accepted head and promotion merge artifacts are both byte-identical to the qualified R15 identity.
After CI-WP-015 merge, the dedicated recovery verifier passes again from main without modifying product semantics.
adversarialTests: Wrong accepted second parent fails the verifier.
Missing or extra promoted path fails exact path-set comparison.
Accepted artifact byte or SHA mismatch fails closed.
Promotion merge artifact byte or SHA mismatch fails closed.
Any learner-journey regression in build, syntax, core, learning, experience, integration or UX clarity fails the verifier.
nonGoals: Changing product code or the accepted R15 learner behavior.
Changing the central Learn-it Next router for a promotion that has already happened.
Changing planner, scoring, evidence, memory, session semantics, kits or contracts.
Reopening the final human UX gate.
General redesign of the CI topology.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate this exact two-file CI-only recovery change.
The immutable R15 Human Replay and accepted exact-head product CI remain the product-semantic authorities; this verifier only reconciles the historical post-merge CI false negative.
The historical failure artifact contains only `post-merge topology differs`, while repository governance passed and all accepted exact-head product/replay evidence was green before merge.
rollback: Revert the CI-WP-015 two-file recovery verifier. The accepted R15 product merge and immutable Human Replay remain unchanged.
